line.comment: * Task 201.
* Add-Ons 1.8.1: Store the timeout. This is used to display the next cycle time in the research GUI.
* Mordan8 - If research is active, use original color or whatever the user set it to, otherwise set to White to signal the user there's no research happening.
* Add-Ons 1.8.1: store the timeout; it is used in the research station GUI to display the time remaining until the next cycle.
* Add-Ons 1.8.1: moved backlog check to new script.
* Place this beforehand because backlog messages will play after.
* No need to set the local to null; already set to null or to next project in Mayhem.CompleteResearch.
* [THIS]-> set local variable: name='mayhem_currentProject' value=null
* Mordan8
* Get any user set color and restore it. Otherwise just set to green (default 7). Set in Mayhem.Cmd.ColourStationName.xml
* 8 = White.
* If the user set their station color to White, we'll use something else to signal a no-research color.
* 5 = Magenta
* Add-Ons 1.8.1: Unused. Moved to Mayhem.CheckBacklog.
* $backlog.research = reverse array $backlog.research
* Add-Ons 1.8.1: Rewrite this. The original iterates from tail-to-head and wastes a bunch of execution time by repeatedly setting the project.
* We must iterate from head-to-tail. A for-each loop will iterate from tail to head.
* $type = get subtype of ware $ware
* Terran and OCV have restrictions.
* Valid project.
